flow.label: LLM Lab stages
flow.plannedTooltip: This stage is planned for a later version.

experiment.title: Try a sentence
experiment.intro: Type something and see how it breaks into tokens.
experiment.privacyFull: Your text is processed in this browser. It is not uploaded or saved.

errors.tooLong: Keep your text to 200 characters or fewer.
errors.load: The Qwen tokenizer could not be loaded. Check the connection and retry.

result.title: Token result
result.discovery: Some words stay together. Others split into smaller pieces.
result.different: Different models may split text differently.
result.whyTitle: Why did it split this way?
result.whyVocabulary: The tokenizer matches text using pieces from its fixed vocabulary.
result.whyCommon: Common text may stay in larger pieces.
result.whyUnusual: Unusual, misspelled or made-up text is often split into smaller pieces.
result.whyMeaning: A token piece does not necessarily have a meaning on its own.
result.whyStep1: It has a set of text pieces.
result.technicalNote: Qwen2.5 tokenizer · Optional raw pieces and IDs. You do not need to memorise them.

tokens.spaceLegend: shows that a space is stored at the start of this token.

challenge.title: Rebuild these tokens
challenge.buildIntro: Reorder the visual token groups to rebuild your text.
challenge.readyIntro: Put the coloured pieces back in order.

status.unavailable: This example is tricky to rebuild. Try another one.

challenge.instructions: Put the groups back in their original order. A group may contain more than one real byte-level token.
challenge.placeholder: Select or drag token groups here
challenge.keyboard: Select a group to add or return it. Use the arrow buttons with a keyboard or touch screen.

feedback.correct: Correct. Your text is rebuilt from the real tokenizer output.
feedback.incorrect: These groups come from the real result, but their order does not yet match the original text.

notice.title: What to notice
notice.prompt: What changed when you edited the text?
notice.missionLink: For a guided introduction, start with Mission 1.

tour.label: LLM Lab guide
tour.clickTarget: Click the highlighted button to continue.

welcome.title: Welcome to LLM Lab
welcome.body:
We’ll show you around in about 30 seconds.

You can replay this guide anytime using the Replay guide button above.

stage.title: Everything starts here
stage.body: A language model first splits text into smaller pieces called tokens.

input.title: Type anything here
input.body: Try English, Chinese, French, German or emoji. Nothing is uploaded.

tokenize.title: Run the tokenizer
tokenize.body: Click here to split your text into real token pieces.

result.title: See the real tokens
result.body: These coloured pieces are the real tokens. Different models may split text differently.

why.title: Want to know why?
why.body: Open here for a simple explanation.

challenge.title: Try it yourself
challenge.body: Rebuild the token pieces in their original order, or finish the guide now.
